settings.title: Shifts
settings.subtitle: Where shifts happen and how people are asked to confirm them. Every change saves right away.

locations.title: Locations
locations.lead: Each location keeps its own time zone, so a shift reads the same for everyone no matter where they open it from.
locations.name: Name
locations.managerHint: Can schedule this location even without the Manage shifts permission.
locations.deleteBody: This location has never been scheduled, so nothing else is affected.
locations.emptyBody: Add the places your team works at: a lab, a branch, a warehouse.
locations.timezoneLocked: The time zone can't change once the location has shifts.
locations.planLimit: Your plan includes {{count}} active location. Upgrade to Growth for unlimited locations.
locations.planLimitReached: You've reached your plan's active location limit. Deactivate one or upgrade to Growth.

confirm.title: Confirmations
confirm.lead: How people find out about their shifts.
confirm.require: Ask people to accept or decline each shift
confirm.requireHint: When off, published shifts count as confirmed right away.
confirm.remindDayBefore: Remind people the day before their shift
confirm.dailyHint: Reminders go out once a day, in the morning.

rules.title: Scheduling rules
rules.lead: Checked every time someone is assigned. Breaking a rule shows a warning; the scheduler can still go ahead.
rules.minRest: Minimum rest between two shifts of the same person

templates.title: Shift templates
templates.lead: Saved start and end times that fill in a new shift with one click. Create them from the shift form.
templates.empty: No templates yet. In the shift form, use “Save these times as a template”.
templates.name: Name

warnings.time_off: Has approved time off that day
warnings.holiday: It's a day off on the company calendar
warnings.unavailable: Said they're unavailable at that time
warnings.outside_availability: Outside the hours they said they're available
warnings.rest: Less than the minimum rest from another shift

blocks.no_user: Needs a Northstack login to get shifts
blocks.overlap: Already has a shift at that time

schedule.title: Schedule
schedule.subtitle: Plan the week, then publish to let everyone know.
schedule.copyConfirmTitle: Copy last week into this one?
schedule.copyConfirmBody: Every shift from {{range}} is added to this week as a draft, with the same people. Nothing is sent until you publish.
schedule.copiedSkipped: {{count}} shifts copied as drafts. {{skipped}} people were left off because they already have a shift then or no longer have a login.
schedule.publishConfirmBody: Everyone on these shifts gets a notification and an email to confirm.
schedule.noLocationsBody: Shifts happen at a location. Set up where your team works in Settings → Shifts.
schedule.published_one: Published {{count}} shift. Everyone on it was notified.
schedule.published_other: Published {{count}} shifts. Everyone on them was notified.
schedule.clickToAdd: Click to add a shift here

form.saveTemplate: Save these times as a template
form.reconfirmWarning: Changing the date, time or location asks everyone on this shift to confirm again.

detail.draftHint: Draft: nobody has been notified. Publish it when it's ready.

mine.subtitle: Your upcoming shifts. Let your team know if you can make each one.

mine.cancelledNote: This shift was cancelled. You don't need to go.

availability.title: My availability
availability.lead: Tell whoever plans the shifts when you can or can't work. They'll see a warning if they schedule you outside it.
availability.emptyWeekly: Nothing set. Without entries, you can be scheduled any day.
